fields.statement: QA at 3a745c744 with the built binary in a scratch Rhiza root, no RHIZA_* env. rhiza daemon settings lists rhiza.daemon.failureClassifier with the claude -p --model haiku default (default, machine); rhiza daemon set ... '' writes "rhiza.daemon.failureClassifier" = "" to rhiza.toml and shows it as "" (rhiza.toml, machine). Against a failing command step: empty ran it once with no classifier line; a fake classifier saw the step's output ('boom') on stdin; 'transient: flaky net', 'TRANSIENT - lock held' and a verdict after blank lines were read as transient; 'real: test fails', a free-text sentence ('I think it is probably transient') and a classifier exiting 3 were all real (no clear verdict / classifier failed: exit status 3). With the setting unset, the real default (Claude headless, Haiku) called a git index.lock 'File exists' error transient and a Go '--- FAIL: TestAdd ... want 2' real, each in about 7s with a one-line reason. A 'sleep 20' classifier held the step 21s: the call has no time limit.

QA at 3a745c744 with the built binary: rhiza run start --foreground on a workflow whose command step fails on its first run. A transient verdict printed 'step failure classified transient; running it once more' and the step ran twice and passed; a real verdict, garbage output, a failing classifier and an empty setting each left it at one run, failed. A step that always fails with a transient classifier ran exactly twice, then failed: one rerun only. With the real Haiku default, an index.lock error was rerun and a Go test assertion failure was not.

QA at 3a745c744 with the built binary: failed autonomous runs (rhiza run start --foreground --autonomous, step printing an HTTP 502 error) then rhiza daemon --once in a scratch root. Classifier empty: logged 'watchdog: run … step a failure classified real, left to the inbox: classifier off' and daemon.state.json records judged for the run. A fake 'transient: github 502' classifier received the failed step's detail on stdin; the watchdog logged 'failed on a transient error (github 502): resumed with --retry (budget 1 of 2)' and filed a bug request. A classifier exiting 2 logged 'classified real, left to the inbox: classifier failed: exit status 2', and a second daemon --once pass did not ask or log again. No transientSignatures remain in the code (grep).

QA at 3a745c744 with the built binary and a fake gh whose failed job 'jest' prints a real-shaped gh --log-failed Jest log (job/step/timestamp prefixes, 3000 noise lines then 'FAIL src/garden.test.js', the expect/Expected/Received lines, 'Tests: 1 failed' and '##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.'). First rhiza ship check --settled --json reran run 42; the second listed tests ['CI run 42 (jest)'] and a finding 'failed on <sha> after its reruns; its failing log lines are saved in .git/rhiza/ship/<cs>-ci-logs/42.log: read them, reproduce the failure locally and fix it'. The saved file was 11 lines, prefixes stripped, holding the FAIL line, the assertion and the summary. A log failing at its first lines followed by 3000 PASS lines saved 20 lines keeping both 'FAIL src/early.test.js' and the closing summary. No Go/RSpec/Minitest/pytest parser remains in non-test code (grep).
